d: Serves as the on-the-ground visual storyteller for the mall, capturing daily life inside the mall and producing photo and video content in-house. By internalising this capability, the role removes the reliance on expensive daily agency photography retainers and delivers highly engaging, trend-driven content natively tailored for luxury, F&B, and active beachfront environments, in line with the luxury and lifestyle positioning of the asset.
r: Capture photo and video content daily across the mall, using smartphone or DSLR setups, showcasing the vibrant energy of tenants, dining, and promenades.

Produce content tailored to the luxury, F&B, and active beachfront environments of the destination, delivering in-house the visual coverage previously sourced from external agency photography retainers.
Deliver social assets and platform-ready clips in line with the monthly content calendar set by the Marketing Team.
Compile and hand over weekly content packs of digital media assets for scheduling.
Cover seasonal activations and major event moments on the ground, generating real-time stories and social assets as they happen.
Spot posting moments as they arise, then capture, caption, and publish content while the moment is still live.
Be present on-site during activations, to support the wider marketing and events effort.
Edit photo and video content into platform-native formats such as Instagram Reels, TikToks, and Shorts, turning content around quickly to keep pace with the tactical content plan.
Use editing software (Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere Pro, or mobile-native editing suites) to a high technical standard, so that assets meet the format requirements of each publishing platform.
Ensure all visual assets reflect the luxury and lifestyle positioning of the mall, with polished layout and lighting execution.
Keep all content aligned to brand guidelines across every publishing channel.
Tailor content to what resonates with Bahraini and GCC audiences, rather than applying a generic social playbook.
Keep content current, trend-aware, and relevant across Instagram and TikTok.
Work closely with the Marketing team to align content with campaign and calendar priorities.
Liaise with tenants and activation teams to access locations, products, and moments worth capturing.

d: Dar, the founding member of the Sidara group, is an international multidisciplinary consulting organization specializing in engineering, architecture, planning, environment, project management, facilities management, and economics. Sidara operates in 60 countries with 55,000 professionals, Dar connects people, places, and communities through innovative solutions to the world's most complex challenges. We deliver projects from inception through completion, embracing challenges to empower communities worldwide. Learn more at www.dar.com.

We aspire to be the chosen home of those with a gift for crafting solutions that empower people and an unwavering passion for learning and innovation. Our core values shape our culture and guide our decision-making. We are committed to:

We are currently seeking an Ethics & Compliance Manager to lead the day-to-day delivery of Dar’s ethics and compliance programme, embedding the Sidara Group standards across Dar’s regions, offices and projects. The role is accountable for third-party due diligence, compliance risk assessment, training, Speak-Up support and compliance reporting, and coordinates Dar’s network of Compliance Officers and champions. It protects Dar’s licence to operate in high-risk markets and enables projects to be won and delivered with integrity.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance or a related field; Master’s degree an advantage.
Recognised compliance certification preferred (e.g. CCEP / CCEP-I, CAMS, CFE, ICA or equivalent); ISO 37001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor an advantage.
Minimum 8 years’ ethics & compliance experience, ideally in a multinational engineering, consulting or professional services firm operating across the Middle East and Africa.
Strong working knowledge of FCPA, UK Bribery Act, ISO 37001, sanctions/export controls, AML and data privacy; proven third-party due diligence and investigations support experience.
Fluent English; Arabic an advantage. Willingness to travel across Dar’s regions.
r: The role encompasses, but is not restricted to, the following responsibilities:

Draft, update and maintain Dar’s ethics and compliance policies and procedures (Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Speak-Up, gifts & hospitality, conflicts of interest, sanctions/export controls, AML), aligned with the Group Code of Conduct and Group policies, and embed them across Dar’s regions and offices.

Run Dar’s third-party due diligence process: screening of clients, JV partners, subconsultants, agents and suppliers on the Group screening platform, enhanced due diligence where required, red-flag resolution and ongoing monitoring.

Provide pre-bid and pre-contract compliance advice on opportunities in high-risk jurisdictions, including sanctions, ABC and AML risk assessments, and escalate material matters under the Group Material Matters Escalation Protocol.
Coordinate and support Dar’s network of local Compliance Officers and compliance champions, setting priorities, tracking actions and building local capability.
Deliver Dar’s compliance training plan, including live sessions across Dar countries and the Corporate Centre and NAVEX e-learning; track and report completion rates.

Manage Speak-Up case intake and triage with Legal and HR; conduct and coordinate compliance investigations, document findings and track corrective actions, while protecting confidentiality, privilege and data privacy.

Coordinate Dar’s annual compliance risk assessment and deliver a risk-based monitoring programme (including transaction, third-party and project reviews); follow up on findings and remediation actions.
Run Dar disclosures and certifications (conflicts of interest, gifts & hospitality, annual Code certification).

Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for the Group Head of Ethics & Compliance, the Sidara Risk & Compliance Committee and Dar leadership, covering training, third-party screening, investigations, monitoring results and remediation.
Monitor regulatory developments in Dar’s key markets and undertake special projects as assigned by the Group Head of Ethics & Compliance.

Acts with integrity and sound judgement, making balanced, risk-based decisions under commercial pressure. Handles sensitive matters with discretion and confidentiality. Builds trust and influences without direct authority across regions, functions and cultures. Takes ownership and delivers to deadlines, communicates compliance requirements clearly and practically to project teams and leadership, and continuously improves ways of working.

d: Nokhbat Segadty Trading Company is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented HR Specialist with 1–2 years of practical experience in Human Resources and Employee Affairs. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience with Saudi government platforms, HR operations, and employee management.
q: 1–2 years of proven experience in Human Resources or Employee Affairs.
Strong hands-on experience with the following Saudi government platforms:
Good knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and HR regulations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
Strong employee follow-up and administrative skills.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
High attention to detail and confidentiality.
Ability to work under pressure and coordinate with different departments.
Experience with HR management systems such as Jisr is preferred.

Candidates must have actual hands-on experience processing government transactions, including employee transfers, Iqama renewals, employment contract authentication, and Wage Protection System compliance.
r: Manage daily HR operations and employee affairs, from onboarding to offboarding.
Handle all transactions on Qiwa , including employment contracts, contract authentication, employee transfers, and employee data updates.
Manage Mudad , including payroll processing, Wage Protection System (WPS) compliance, and related requirements.
Handle Muqeem transactions, including Iqama renewals, exit/re-entry visas, final exit visas, and document validity tracking.
Manage GOSI (General Organization for Social Insurance) , including employee registration, termination, salary updates, and employee information.
Handle Balady platform transactions, including municipal license issuance, renewals, and branch-related requirements.
Monitor employee attendance, absences, lateness, leave requests, and overtime.
Follow up with employees regularly to ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and workplace regulations.
Maintain and update employee records, employment contracts, and HR documentation.
Monitor the expiration and renewal of Iqamas, work permits, medical insurance, and other official documents.
Prepare HR letters, internal announcements, warning letters, disciplinary notices, and investigation reports in accordance with Saudi Labor Law.
Coordinate recruitment activities, employee onboarding, and new employee documentation.
Handle employee inquiries, concerns, and HR-related requests professionally.
Prepare periodic HR reports covering attendance, absences, leave balances, and employee compliance.
Coordinate with department managers regarding employee performance, attendance, and administrative matters.

d: The Near Patient Physician Lead serves as the in-country clinical authority and subject matter expert on the local healthcare system. The role provides clinical leadership, governance, and oversight to ensure patients receive timely, high-quality, and coordinated care while navigating local healthcare services.

The Physician Lead acts as the primary liaison between local clinical teams, healthcare providers, and stakeholders, supporting care coordination, quality assurance, and continuous improvement. The role focuses on proactive patient management, optimizing care pathways, strengthening provider relationships, and ensuring compliance with clinical standards.
q: Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
Ability to work across cultures and in matrix environments.
Medical Doctor with at least 5 years of post-graduate clinical experience.
Broad clinical background in primary care, internal medicine, emergency medicine, critical care, or related specialties.
Experience in medical evacuations and healthcare operations is advantageous.
r: Provide clinical guidance and supervision for complex cases.
Support referrals, specialist consultations, hospital admissions, and medical evacuations.
Participate in case reviews and clinical discussions.
Review medical documentation for quality and compliance.
Escalate clinical risks, complaints, and service concerns.
Support quality investigations and corrective action plans.
Monitor clinical KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
Act as a clinical resource for nursing and operational teams.
Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and professional development.
Assist with workload prioritization and case management.
Participate in stakeholder meetings and provide clinical expertise.
Promote collaboration across clinical, quality, and operational functions.
Maintain relationships with healthcare providers and healthcare facilities.
Represent the organization in clinical meetings and stakeholder engagements.
Support provider assessments, quality reviews, and network development.
Facilitate effective communication between all parties involved in patient care.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.

To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.

Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.

To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.

As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
q: Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
Familiarity with public or private cloud management
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

d: HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Senior Telecom Engineer to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will deliver program-level telecommunications and ICT engineering expertise and technical governance for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity.

You will be providing program-level technical expertise, engineering assurance, and collaborative oversight for reviewing and monitoring all telecommunications, ICT, and smart infrastructure designs across the program, ensuring all fiber optic networks, communication systems, and digital infrastructure submissions are fully integrated and compliant with approved standards, service provider requirements, and operational needs under the direction of the Technical Manager, while supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Communications Engineering, ICT Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
Chartered Professional membership or equivalent professional accreditation.
Minimum fifteen (15) years of professional experience in telecommunications infrastructure, ICT systems, fiber optic networks, smart city infrastructure, or major capital projects.

Experience within PMCM, PMC, consultancy, developer, telecommunications operators, or client-side organizations, preferably on large-scale infrastructure and land development projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region.
Telecommunications Engineering Design Review & ICT Infrastructure
Fiber Optic Networks & Communications Systems Architecture
Smart City Infrastructure & Digital Infrastructure Planning
Telecommunications Utility Coordination & Network Capacity Assessment
Technical Compliance Review & Engineering Assurance Frameworks
Technical Reporting & Telecom Service Provider Coordination
Leadership, Strategic Thinking, Communication, Team Collaboration, and Problem Solving
r: Review telecommunications engineering reports, ICT strategies, network studies, and design drawings prepared by Lead Developers to verify compliance with approved criteria and Client’s requirements.
Assess fiber optic backbone networks, telecommunications duct banks, and network architectures for functionality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Evaluate smart city infrastructure proposals, intelligent systems integration, and digital infrastructure initiatives to ensure future-ready and scalable capabilities.
Support the implementation of program-level technical governance and engineering assurance processes across all package submissions.
Coordinate with the Technical Manager, Senior Electrical Engineer, and program technical teams to resolve interface conflicts and integrate multidisciplinary infrastructure designs.
Evaluate the technical, operational, and lifecycle impacts of design changes and telecommunications-related Value Engineering proposals submitted by Lead Developers.
Provide specialist engineering expertise during technical workshops, design reviews, and coordination meetings to resolve project implementation issues.
Collaborate with Lead Developers, consultants, telecom service providers, and regulatory authorities to streamline network connectivity and secure authority approvals.
Prepare technical review comments, engineering assessments, and executive summaries for the Technical Manager, PMCM Management, and the Client.
Identify and mitigate telecommunications and ICT-related compliance risks while promoting engineering excellence, digital transformation, and continuous improvement across the program.
